description: This file contains the implementation of an Android activity named 'EditEventActivity' which manages editing, saving, and deleting calendar events within the app. It handles user interactions such as saving and deleting events, making use of a repository for data operations, and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: EditEventActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class allowing users to create, edit, and delete calendar events with associated user interface components and event handling logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI binding, retrieves the event ID, and defines click listeners for the save and delete buttons.
